cd /workspace/tests && python3 - << 'EOF'
src = open('cases.py').read()
old_start = src.index("    # internal_only rule")
old_end = src.index("# ------------------------------------------------------- requests and plan")
src = src[:old_start] + """    # internal_only rule: I={e1}, E={e3}; e1 open, e3 closed -> [e1]
    e3 = low('L', 3)
    rows = [
        ['icmp', 'a', '0', '2', 'put', 'L', '1', '0/i1', e1, e1, 'echo', '', '', ''],
        ['icmp', 'b', '0', '2', 'put', 'L', '1', '0/i2', e2, e3, 'echo', '', '', ''],
        ['app', 'm', '0', '5', 'put', 'L', '3', '', e1, '', 'open', 'W', '0', ''],
        ['app', 'n', '0', '5', 'put', 'L', '3', '', e3, '', 'closed', 'W', '0', ''],
    ]
    r = run(base_job(captures=[csv_capture(rows)]))
    lease = r['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]
    svc = lease['services'][0]
    eq('census:ionly-closed', (svc['internal_open'], svc['external_closed'],
                               svc['internal_only'], lease['internal'],
                               lease['external']),
       ([e1], [e3], [e1], [e1], [e3]))
    rows.append(['app', 'p', '0', '5', 'put', 'L', '3', '', e3, '', 'timeout', 'W', '0', ''])
    r = run(base_job(captures=[csv_capture(rows)]))
    svc = r['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0]
    eq('census:ionly-unknown', (svc['internal_open'], svc['external_closed'],
                                svc['internal_only']), ([e1], [], []))
    # E empty -> internal_only empty even with internal opens
    rows = [
        ['icmp', 'a', '0', '2', 'put', 'L', '1', '0/i1', e1, e1, 'echo', '', '', ''],
        ['app', 'm', '0', '5', 'put', 'L', '3', '', e1, '', 'open', 'W', '0', ''],
    ]
    r = run(base_job(captures=[csv_capture(rows)]))
    svc = r['snapshots'][0]['leases'][0]['services'][0]
    eq('census:ionly-no-external', (svc['internal_open'], svc['internal_only']),
       ([e1], []))

""" + src[old_end:]
open('cases.py','w').write(src)
EOF
